ops.oldText: Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
ops.newText: Customer is not required to disclose or match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have flipped the operator so that we are not required to disclose or match any more favourable third-party offer: our playbook does not accept MFN obligations running against the customer, and this obligation contradicted § 12.3, in which Vendor acknowledges we have made no most-favoured-customer commitment. MFN pricing in our favour remains welcome.
proposal.summary: Negate the customer-side disclose-and-match MFN obligation in § 7.2.
